audit.why: 6/10 EVEN against a 51.35% win rate is honest, and the shipped chart (Ornn 4 / Skill 3) with your only real edges at 4-5 fits a lane that flatlines into a tank mirror. Full and content layers agree row for row, so no flip is proposed.

Spike order holds. Worth knowing behind it: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100 against All Out's 120/100/80, so your ultimate is back first at every rank — that is the real reason the 6 window is a wash rather than his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ornn's ability slots are swapped everywhere on this page. It calls Searing Charge his W and the magma pillar his E. Searing Charge is E (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, 450 range — the charge that knocks up on terrain collision), the pillar comes from Volcanic Rupture, which is Q (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 800 range), and W is Bellows Breath — the fire breath that applies Brittle. On top of that, wants.foe[1] credits Brittle to 'passive auto-attacks'; Living Forge is item forging and bonus resists and applies no Brittle at all. Brittle comes from Bellows Breath (W) and Call of the Forge God (R). Two more: 'W (Path Maker) charges through his poke unstoppable' — Riot's text says only 'charges up, taking reduced damage', unstoppable is not in the kit; and 'Q3 knocks him up and pulls him in' — Ntofo Strikes pulls on its second stack and never knocks up.
audit.why: Every one of these is a targeting instruction. A player told to bait 'his W' will bait Bellows Breath and then eat the Searing Charge knock-up that was the actual threat, and a player told Path Maker makes him unstoppable will charge into a knock-up expecting to ignore it.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture (Q) drops the pillar; Searing Charge (E) charges and knocks up on terrain collision; Bellows Breath (W) applies Brittle; Call of the Forge God (R, 140/120/100s, 2500 range) also applies Brittle and can be recast to redirect the elemental. Path Maker's charge reduces damage taken; the second Ntofo Strikes stack pulls.

audit.whatIsWrong: The punishable-cooldown advice pointed at the wrong ability slot.
audit.why: The window you actually want is Searing Charge down — that is his only dash and his only self-peel — and it is 14s at rank 1, the longest basic cooldown in his kit.
audit.corrected: Bait Searing Charge (E), then take the trade inside those 14 seconds.

edits.before: Neither of us does anything at Level 1 — you only have Q, he only has his brittle auto, so just farm with the edge of Ntofo Strikes. The lane wakes up at 3 when your Q-W-E is online: W (Path Maker) charges through his poke unstoppable, and a charged release stuns him if you pin him to a wall, then Q3 knocks him up and pulls him in. Watch for his Searing Charge (W) into a pillar (E) — that's his whole early trade, a knockup against terrain; if you W into it unstoppable, his one combo does nothing and you walk out ahead.
edits.after: Neither side does anything at Level 1 — you only have Q, he only has autos, so farm at the edge of Ntofo Strikes. The lane wakes up at 3 when your full kit is online: Path Maker (W) charges through his poke taking reduced damage, and the release stuns him if you pin him to a wall, then your second Q stack pulls him back in. Watch for Volcanic Rupture (Q) into Searing Charge (E) — that pillar-and-charge knock-up is his whole early trade; charge W through it and his one combo does nothing.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your window — you out-bully an immobile tank when you trade on his cooldowns. Bait his Searing Charge (W); once that pillar dash is down he can't escape or re-stun you, so step in, W-pin him, Q3, and bank the trade. At 6 don't over-respect All Out: it gives you a duelist 1v1 but peels off your tankiness, and his Call of the Forge God (R) can hit you with two knockups, so save R as a counter-engage or peel tool rather than a flashy solo-kill button. This is an even tank mirror that you edge on the cooldown trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your window — you out-bully an immobile tank when you trade on his cooldowns. edits.before: Late game this flatlines — you both build full tank, neither of you kills the other, and your armor stacking does nothing against an Ornn who just exists to peel and CC. The fight is decided in the 5v5, not the lane: your R (All Out) yanking his carry out vs his R double knockup setting up his team. Make sure you're the one peeling for your carries with All Out's recall, because if his Forge God lands on your backline first, his free-upgrade itemized team wins the exchange. Close any small lead earlier — there's no scaling 1v1 to win here.

notes: The packet's two suspectNames here are both FALSE POSITIVES — 'Searing Charge' and 'All Out' are the correct names. The genuine defect the checker could not see was the slot letters: Searing Charge was labelled W and the magma pillar E across six fields, when they are E and Q. Two full-layer fields still carry the wrong-slot phrasing and I had no length-safe rewrite for them: dosFull[1].t 'Dodge his Q knockup' (Q is the pillar, the knock-up is E) and dontsFull[1] 'Get brittle-procced' (fine, but it never says Brittle comes from W and R). Worth a follow-up pass.
